description: Search products across the marketplaces Escrova can actually buy from today. Six sources are searchable: amazon, ebay, walmart, bestbuy, homedepot, wayfair, or "all". GET /api/products/search. No wallet and no signature. Send q, cat, or both; page and every selected filter are preserved together. A brands[].engineParam returned by get_category goes into engineParam here and is sent as the typed eBay aspect filter, while Google refinements use shoprs. The REST pagination and degraded-source metadata are returned unchanged. For some stores, "cheapest first" only orders the returned page; sortScope is "page" or "store". A search is one guess at what somebody meant and it spends a paid provider call; when you know roughly what department a thing is in, list_categories and get_category narrow further for less.

cat.description: Department slug, category id, or <id>-<slug> returned by get_category.

engineParam.description: A brands[].engineParam from get_category; sent only as ebayAspectFilter.

q.description: What to search for. Optional when cat is supplied.

shoprs.description: A Google filter option whose engineParamType is shoprs.

name: search_products
title: Search the connected marketplaces
